acceptance_criteria: Registry v2 and v1-readable migration are acceptance-proven, idempotent, and fail closed for unknown native/production fields.
Registered dataset versions point only to complete artifact contracts: metadata.json, validation.json, manifest.json, ohlcv.jsonl, raw response/request/redacted headers/provider notes.
Validation reports fail production eligibility for timestamp, duplicate, OHLC, volume, metadata, checksum, or missing artifact errors.
Backtest gates refuse missing, invalid, non-native, degraded, metadata-incomplete, checksum-mismatched, or loose-file datasets; diagnostic override remains exploratory and cannot promote.
Owned CLI commands parse and dispatch with --target support; TUI aliases are discovered and tested rather than assumed.
artifact_requirements: Each healthy dataset version must contain metadata.json, validation.json, manifest.json, ohlcv.jsonl, raw/response.*, raw/request.json, raw/headers.redacted.json, and raw/provider-notes.md.
Validation reports must be referenced from registry records.
Diagnostic backtest reports must list every overridden issue and mark promotion_eligible=false.
focused_verification: Run focused registry migration/idempotency tests.
Run focused artifact-contract and validation fixture tests for invalid timestamps, duplicates, bad OHLC, missing metadata, and volume failures.
Run focused backtest data gate tests for invalid/degraded/non-native/checksum/loose path refusal.
Run CLI parse tests for list --json, export, validate, and backtest diagnostic/promotion paths.
Run TUI slash-alias routing tests for owned data commands.

acceptance_criteria: Provider capability checks persist redacted-safe can_fetch=false results for missing credentials, blocks, unsupported intervals, 401/403/404, and provider errors.
TradingView fetch uses exact native timeframes only, records MCP/chart limitations honestly, persists full artifacts on success, and writes no healthy registry entry on unavailable/partial results.
OpenBB/Polygon detects credential presence before full fetch, never mislabels provider identity, records adjusted/unadjusted/session metadata, and redacts secrets.
Stooq exact-native support either ingests direct native data with full artifacts or records provider_blocked_or_unavailable; no bot bypass or resampling path may create production-eligible data.
yfinance fallback is always degraded/non-promotion, writes fallback metadata when successful, and cannot satisfy promotion gates even under diagnostic override.
Snapshot artifacts include provider timestamp/captured_at metadata and stale-after-5-min fail-closed classification.
Owned CLI and TUI provider command paths parse, dispatch, and test all required mandatory flags.
artifact_requirements: .archon/trading-lab/data/provider-capabilities.json with checked_at, unavailable reasons, native_interval, and fail-closed can_fetch state.
Successful provider-native dataset versions must satisfy TASK-TDL-010 artifact contract.
Snapshots must be stored under .archon/trading-lab/data/snapshots/<provider>/<symbol>/ with captured timestamp metadata.
Unavailable provider outcomes must be stored/reported as capability, coverage, or residual-gap records, not healthy dataset registry entries.
focused_verification: Run provider capability persistence/redaction tests.
Run mocked TradingView MCP capability/native ingest/snapshot/staleness tests.
Run OpenBB/Polygon missing-credential, redaction, and fixture normalization tests.
Run Stooq CSV fixture, non-data HTML/block fixture, and native interval refusal tests.
Run yfinance fallback metadata, interval limitation, and promotion refusal tests.
Run CLI parse and TUI alias tests for fetch-native and snapshot provider paths.

acceptance_criteria: Coverage matrix covers ES, NQ, SPY, QQQ, BTCUSDT, and ETHUSDT across 1W, 1D, 240, 60, and 15.
Coverage JSON schema matches PRD §23 and text report is human-readable.
Provider selection order and freshness defaults are applied; snapshots older than 5 minutes are stale.
Gaps include exact reasons and are not treated as pass conditions.
--target is supported consistently.
/trading data coverage ... has TUI parity and tested routing.
artifact_requirements: .archon/trading-lab/data/coverage/<run-or-timestamp>/coverage.json or equivalent durable JSON report path must exist.
Readable coverage report artifact must exist or be emitted with an output path when requested.
Coverage gaps must list canonical instrument, timeframe, selected provider/fallback, native status, row count, quality status, freshness, and reason.
focused_verification: Run coverage matrix generation test for the full trading-core-v1 universe/timeframe grid.
Run provider selection order and freshness classification tests.
Run JSON/text output tests.
Run CLI parse test for data coverage --universe trading-core-v1 --json.
Run TUI /trading data coverage alias routing test.

acceptance_criteria: AHDM evidence inventory is generated only after coverage/backtest gate availability is checked; incomplete coverage records gaps and blocks promotion-oriented strategy work.
Every rule in citations.json is cited or explicitly hypothesis; hypotheses are barred from promotion.

StrategySpec references registered dataset ids/versions, not loose files, and includes exact PRD weights, evidence requirements, thresholds, entry models, sizing/risk, promotion gates, and residual gaps.
Pine indicator/strategy artifacts are generated from the shared rule manifest; Pine results remain exploratory only; unavailable compile tooling creates a fail-closed residual gap.
AHDM native backtest consumes registered validated datasets and the shared manifest, writes required replay artifacts, and refuses invalid/non-native/degraded data unless diagnostic-only.
Adversarial review and paper-trading readiness reports check all PRD done-definition items; failed gates block readiness promotion; no live trading or high-probability claim is made.
focused_verification: Run citation artifact shape and rule inventory validation tests.
Run StrategySpec schema, dataset reference, weight sum, entry model, no-trade threshold, and risk sizing tests.
Run Pine artifact generation and static structure tests; run compile/check only if tooling exists and record fail-closed otherwise.
Run AHDM native backtest happy-path fixture, refusal, replayability, costs/slippage, and shared manifest parity tests.
Run readiness/adversarial artifact path and residual gap schema tests.
